It’s a perfect place for lavish meal either with family or friends.

[{"Name":"Nikhil Kumar patel","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWmxjPuMZXbF1AJZOKAmiumIW3Vo0mmj_NhDGfpBsbhiTLImOO8Ig=s120-c-rp-mo-ba12-br100","Rating":4,"Description":"Civic Center

Tripti Restaurant, located in the bustling Civic Center area, is a well-known dining destination that lives up to its name by offering true satisfaction to its guests. With its welcoming ambiance, quality food, and attentive service, Tripti has established itself as a reliable choice for families, professionals, and food lovers. Based on the overall experience, the restaurant deserves a solid four-star rating.

One of the first things that stands out about Tripti is its pleasant and well-maintained environment. The restaurant features a clean and comfortable interior with tasteful décor that creates a calm and inviting atmosphere. Soft lighting, neatly arranged seating, and good ventilation make it suitable for both casual meals and small gatherings. Whether you are visiting for lunch, dinner, or a special occasion, the ambiance feels relaxed and enjoyable. The Civic Center location adds to its convenience, making it easily accessible for locals as well as visitors.

The food at Tripti is undoubtedly the highlight of the restaurant. The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, focusing mainly on Indian cuisine while also including a few popular multi-cuisine options. From traditional vegetarian meals to rich curries, fresh breads, and flavorful rice dishes, the variety ensures that there is something for everyone. The ingredients used are fresh, and the presentation of the food is appealing without being overly fancy.

The taste of the dishes reflects consistency and balance. The flavors are well-developed, not overly spicy, and suitable for a wide range of preferences. Signature dishes stand out for their aroma and texture, and the portion sizes are generous, providing good value for money. The desserts are also worth mentioning, as they are freshly prepared and provide a satisfying end to the meal.

Service at Tripti is another strong point. The staff members are polite, attentive, and well-trained. They are quick to respond to requests and are happy to help with menu suggestions. Orders are served in a timely manner, and the staff ensures that guests are comfortable throughout their visit. The professionalism of the service team adds to the overall positive dining experience.

Cleanliness and hygiene standards at Tripti are commendable. The dining area, tables, and restrooms are regularly cleaned and well-maintained. This attention to hygiene creates confidence among customers and enhances the overall impression of the restaurant. In today’s times, maintaining such standards is extremely important, and Tripti handles it well.

In terms of pricing, Tripti falls into a moderate range. The prices are reasonable considering the quality of food, service, and location. While it may not be the cheapest option in the area, it certainly offers value for money. The restaurant is suitable for family outings, business lunches, and small celebrations without putting too much pressure on the budget.

Overall, Tripti Restaurant in Civic Center offers a satisfying dining experience with its good food, comfortable ambiance, courteous service, and cleanliness. Tripti Restaurant, located in the bustling Civic Center area, is a well-known dining destination that lives up to its name by offering true satisfaction to its guests. With its welcoming ambiance, quality food, and attentive service, Tripti has established itself as a reliable choice for families, professionals, and food lovers. Based on the overall experience, the restaurant deserves a solid four-star rating.

One of the first things that stands out about Tripti is its pleasant and well-maintained environment. The restaurant features a clean and comfortable interior with tasteful décor that creates a calm and inviting atmosphere. Soft lighting, neatly arranged seating, and good ventilation make it suitable for both casual meals and small gatherings. Whether you are visiting for lunch, dinner, or a special occasion, the ambiance feels relaxed and enjoyable. The Civic Center location adds to its convenience, making it easily accessible for locals as well as visitors.

The food at Tripti is undoubtedly the highlight of the restaurant. The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, focusing mainly on Indian cuisine while also including a few popular multi-cuisine options. From traditional vegetarian meals to rich curries, fresh breads, and flavorful rice dishes, the variety ensures that there is something for everyone. The ingredients used are fresh, and the presentation of the food is appealing without being overly fancy.

The taste of the dishes reflects consistency and balance. The flavors are well-developed, not overly spicy, and suitable for a wide range of preferences. Signature dishes stand out for their aroma and texture, and the portion sizes are generous, providing good value for money. The desserts are also worth mentioning, as they are freshly prepared and provide a satisfying end to the meal.

Service at Tripti is another strong point. The staff members are polite, attentive, and well-trained. They are quick to respond to requests and are happy to help with menu suggestions. Orders are served in a timely manner, and the staff ensures that guests are comfortable throughout their visit. The professionalism of the service team adds to the overall positive dining experience.

Cleanliness and hygiene standards at Tripti are commendable. The dining area, tables, and restrooms are regularly cleaned and well-maintained. This attention to hygiene creates confidence among customers and enhances the overall impression of the restaurant. In today’s times, maintaining such standards is extremely important, and Tripti handles it well.

In terms of pricing, Tripti falls into a moderate range. The prices are reasonable considering the quality of food, service, and location. While it may not be the cheapest option in the area, it certainly offers value for money. The restaurant is suitable for family outings, business lunches, and small celebrations without putting too much pressure on the budget.

Overall, Tripti Restaurant in Civic Center offers a satisfying dining experience with its good food, comfortable ambiance, courteous service, and cleanliness. While there is always room for minor improvements, such as expanding the menu or enhancing décor details, the restaurant performs well in all essential areas. The food at Tripti is simply exceptional! I had the pleasure of trying their lunch menu, and each dish was expertly prepared and presented. The flavors were rich and authentic, and the portion sizes were generous.

The staff at Tripti are friendly, attentive, and courteous.

Tripti offers two types of seating arrangements: ground floor and first floor. The first-floor seating area is ideal for family get-togethers, kitty parties, and birthday celebrations. They also have a banquet hall perfect for anniversaries or 1st birthday celebrations.

Besides their excellent restaurant services, Tripti also offers a range of snacks, squashes, and other packed food items, making it a one-stop-shop for all your food needs.

The food at Tripti is simply exceptional! I had the pleasure of trying their lunch menu, and each dish was expertly prepared and presented. The flavors were rich and authentic, and the portion sizes were generous.

The staff at Tripti are friendly, attentive, and courteous.

Tripti offers two types of seating arrangements: ground floor and first floor. The first-floor seating area is ideal for family get-togethers, kitty parties, and birthday celebrations. They also have a banquet hall perfect for anniversaries or 1st birthday celebrations.

Food & Taste:
The taste is genuinely impressive, especially for non-veg dishes. We tried:

Drums of Heaven – ⭐⭐⭐⭐absolutely super tasty, perfectly cooked and flavorful.

Chicken Kolhapuri – ⭐⭐⭐decent in taste with good spice balance.

Paneer Kolhapuri – ⭐⭐⭐⭐ surprisingly awesome, rich gravy and well-cooked paneer.

Garlic Naan & Tandoori Roti – ⭐⭐⭐⭐soft, fresh and paired really well with the gravies.

Steam Rice – ⭐⭐⭐fresh and perfectly cooked.

Price & Quantity:
The price and quantity are totally worth it. Portions are generous, and for the taste they serve, it feels value-for-money.

Staff & Service:
The staff was really good and polite. Service was quick and they made sure we got everything on time.

What Could Be Better:
The only drawbacks are the hygiene and seating area, which need improvement. Also, parking is a big issue since there is no dedicated parking space, making it a bit difficult to manage during rush hours.

Overall:
If you’re looking for tasty food—especially non-veg—Aman Dhaba is definitely worth a visit. Just be prepared for parking and seating If you're craving authentic, mouthwatering Indian cuisine, look no further than Netaji Dhaba! This hidden gem delivers an incredible dining experience that leaves you wanting more.

The ambiance strikes a perfect balance between cozy and vibrant, giving you the feel of a traditional Indian dhaba with a modern twist. The service is impeccable—warm, friendly, and attentive without being intrusive.

Now, onto the food: absolutely divine! Each dish is a masterpiece, bursting with authentic flavors and made with the freshest ingredients. Their butter chicken is rich, creamy, and perfectly spiced, while the biryani is fragrant and packed with tantalizing layers of flavor. Don't miss out on the tandoori items—they are grilled to perfection with just the right amount of smoky char. Vegetarians will love their paneer tikka and dal makhani, which are equally delightful.

The portions are generous, and the prices are more than reasonable for the quality and taste you get. Whether you're looking for a casual meal with friends or celebrating a special occasion, Netaji Dhaba ensures a memorable experience.

Highly recommended! While the hotel has a convenient location and some basic facilities, it falls short in several important areas that impact guest comfort.

The location of the hotel is one of its few advantages. It is easily accessible and situated in a part of the city that makes commuting relatively convenient. For travelers who need a place just to stay overnight, the location can be helpful. However, beyond this, the experience does not offer much to appreciate.

The rooms were quite disappointing. Cleanliness was not up to the mark, and there were visible signs of poor maintenance. Bedsheets and washrooms did not feel properly maintained, and the overall hygiene level could definitely be improved. Some basic amenities were either not available or not functioning properly, which made the stay uncomfortable. The furniture and interiors also appeared outdated and worn out, giving the room a neglected feel.

The service at the hotel was inconsistent. While the staff members were generally polite and tried to be helpful, the response time was slow. Simple requests took longer than expected, which suggests a lack of proper coordination or management. Better staff training and quicker service could significantly improve the guest experience.

Food quality was another area that needs attention. The menu options were limited, and the taste of the food was average at best. It did not meet expectations, especially for guests who prefer to dine within the hotel. Hygiene in the dining area could also be improved. Enhancing both the quality and variety of food would make a noticeable difference.

The overall atmosphere of the hotel feels outdated and lacks proper upkeep. The property seems to have potential, but it requires renovation and better maintenance to match even basic hospitality standards. Currently, it does not provide the comfort and quality that most travelers expect.

In conclusion, my stay at Hotel Ashish International was not very satisfying. While it may serve as a budget option for a short stay, it does not offer a pleasant or comfortable experience. I would only recommend it to those who are looking for a very basic accommodation and are willing to compromise on cleanliness and service.

With improvements in hygiene, maintenance, food quality, and service efficiency, the hotel could become a much better place
